note: Inyo NF campground at 9,600 ft beside Rock Creek Lake in Rock Creek Canyon, about 10 miles up from Tom's Place off US 395. Only sites 007-013 take an RV and none posts a length, so a 23-ft rig should call or check site photos before booking; the lake-overlooking sites are tent walk-ins. Electric-motor-only boating; boat rentals, a store and showers are nearby. Active bear area, bear boxes at every site. --Claude
summary: FS page, rec.gov facility/rules/rates/catalog and RV-site photos, OSM, imagery and 3DEP read. Reservable on rec.gov, $35 (+$10 extra vehicle), 14-night max, soft 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums. 26 sites but only 7 take an RV (007-013), no lengths posted - stored 30 ft cleared. Flush toilets and potable water (FS) - stored vault_toilets cleared. No hookups confirmed. Closed for the season now (normal). Pin 488 m off on the group campground across the lake - re-pin. Lakeview recommended down to not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT (downgrade, lakeview -> not waterfront): the RV sites are 007-013. Their rec.gov photos (all seven) show pines, aspen and boulders and no lake; site 013 (37.45120,-118.73517) is 73 m from the OSM shoreline and 9.4 m above it (3DEP 2964.2 vs 2954.8 m), site 012 (37.45131,-118.73473) 110 m, with the campground road between the sites and the shore. The agency prose ('sit on a low hill overlooking the lake') is general, and rec.gov says the lake-overlooking sites are the tent-only walk-ins (001-006; walk-to 003 is 46 m from the shore). With no RV site shown to see the lake, it goes down per the default-down rule. Replacement evidence: 'RV sites 007-013 only (rest tent/walk-to). rec.gov photos of all seven show no lake; 013 is 73 m and 9 m above the shore, 012 110 m, campground road between. Lake-overlooking sites are tent walk-ins. Not waterfront for a rig.'

PIN MOVE (488 m): stored 37.45382,-118.73901 is the rec.gov facility point and sits on OSM's 'Rock Creek Lake Group Campground' (group_only) on the far NW shore. Target 37.45046,-118.73547 (centroid of the posted rec.gov site points, on the east-shore loops; OSM family campground centroid 37.44903,-118.73582; FS posts 37.44910,-118.73630). Open-Meteo elevation 2959 m vs stored 2965.
